capabilities: Toggle a note between the Markdown editor and a mindmap view via a mindmap: true frontmatter flag
Edit the note's structure with keyboard commands that create, delete, indent, and reorder nodes
Fold, unfold, zoom, and pan the map with mouse, touch, or stylus
Set heading levels (Ctrl+1-6) and toggle bold/italic on selected node text
Render inline Markdown formatting, checkboxes, links, and tags inside nodes
extras: README and manifest description are in French only. Installation is manual: the user downloads manifest.json, main.js, and styles.css into a plugin folder rather than through a marketplace listing.
problem: Obsidian only offers linear text views, so there is no visual tree way to see and restructure a note's heading and bullet hierarchy.

relations.evidence: avec certains raccourcis usuels de clavier de FreePlane

summary: Mindmap view and editor that renders a Markdown note's headings and bullets as an editable FreeMind-style tree while the file stays a plain .md note.
